abstract:
The aim of this prospective study is to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of endoscopic ultrasound-guided shear wave elastography (EUS-SWE) in patients with solid pancreatic lesions. During a clinically indicated EUS with fine-needle biopsy, tissue stiffness will be measured by shear wave elastography in the pancreatic lesion and in the adjacent normal pancreatic parenchyma. Elastography values will be compared with the final cytological/histological diagnosis in order to assess the ability of EUS-SWE to differentiate malignant from benign lesions and to correlate stiffness with histological findings.

Elastography is a non-invasive imaging method for assessing tissue stiffness. Strain elastography provides qualitative/semi-quantitative information but depends on operator-applied pressure. Shear wave elastography (SWE) uses an acoustic radiation force impulse generated by the transducer to produce shear waves, allowing quantitative stiffness measurements. Transabdominal elastography of the pancreas is limited by the deep anatomical location of the organ; EUS-guided SWE overcomes this limitation.

Consecutive adult patients referred to the Regional Institute of Gastroenterology and Hepatology Cluj-Napoca with a solid pancreatic lesion confirmed or suspected on transabdominal ultrasound, CT or MRI will be enrolled after signing informed consent.

Procedure: EUS will be performed under sedation using an Olympus linear echoendoscope connected to a Canon Aplio i800 ultrasound system with shear wave elastography capability. After identification of the target lesion, SWE measurements will be obtained within the lesion and in the normal pancreatic parenchyma, followed by EUS-guided fine-needle biopsy as per standard of care. SWE measurements are expected to prolong the procedure by approximately 4 minutes.

Safety: patients will be monitored for at least 24 hours after the procedure (vital signs, blood count, CRP, amylase, lipase within 12 hours, abdominal ultrasound within 24 hours). Adverse events up to 7 days after the procedure will be recorded.

Reference standard: final diagnosis based on EUS-FNB cytology/histology, surgical histology when available, or clinical and imaging follow-up.

Statistical analysis: continuous variables will be reported as mean ± SD or median (IQR), categorical variables as counts and percentages. Diagnostic performance (sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, accuracy) and ROC curve analysis with optimal cut-off determination will be calculated using IBM SPSS Statistics.
key_points_ko: 목표 인원은 62명이며, 고형 췌장 병변 환자에서 EUS-SWE의 진단 정확도를 평가합니다.
초음파를 이용해 병변 및 인접 정상 췌장 실질의 조직 강도를 정량적으로 측정합니다.
최종 진단은 EUS-FNB 세포학적/조직학적 진단, 수술 조직검사, 또는 임상 및 영상 추적관찰을 기준으로 합니다.

summary_ko: 이 전향적 임상시험은 고형 췌장 병변 환자에서 내시경 초음파 유도하 전단파 탄성파 촬영술(EUS-SWE)의 진단 정확도를 평가합니다. 연구 대상은 18세에서 85세 사이의 고형 췌장 병변이 확인되거나 의심되는 성인 환자 62명입니다. 표준 치료인 내시경 초음파 유도하 세침조직검사(EUS-FNB) 시 병변의 조직 강도를 측정하여 악성과 양성 병변을 구별하는 능력을 평가합니다. 결과 지표로 민감도, 특이도, 양성예측도, 음성예측도, 정확도를 계산합니다.
title: Endoscopic Ultrasound Shear Wave Elastography in Solid Pancreatic Lesions
title_ko: 고형 췌장 병변에서 내시경 초음파 전단파 탄성파 촬영술

trial.eligibility_ko:
선정 기준:
* 연령 18~85세
* 경초음파, CT, MRI에서 확인되거나 의심되는 고형 췌장 병변
* 서면 동의서 서명

제외 기준:
* 중단할 수 없는 항응고제/항혈소판제 치료
* 응고 장애: INR > 1.5 또는 혈소판 수 < 50,000/mm3
* EUS 동안 병변이 확인되지 않음
* 임신
* 서면 동의서 서명 거부
* 내시경 금기증
* 진정(수면마취) 금기증
trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-85 years
* Solid pancreatic lesion confirmed or suspected on transabdominal ultrasound, CT or MRI
* Signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy that cannot be interrupted
* Coagulation disorders: INR \> 1.5 or platelet count \< 50,000/mm3
* Lesion not identified during EUS
* Pregnancy
* Refusal to sign informed consent
* Contraindication to endoscopy
* Contraindication to sedation
